once-upon-a-time-in-hollywood.overview: A faded television actor and his stunt double strive to achieve fame and success in the film industry during the final years of Hollywood's Golden Age in 1969 Los Angeles.

reviews.quote: A gorgeous fever dream, funny and sharp, and a series of love letters — to Los Angeles, to the movies, to a lost time.

podcasts.name: The Rewatchables
podcasts.episode: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood

podcasts.name: Blank Check
podcasts.episode: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood

caligula-the-ultimate-cut.overview: The restored vision of the controversial 1979 epic chronicling the rise and fall of Rome's most infamous emperor, Caligula, in a tale of power and depravity.

lolita-1997.overview: Adrian Lyne's adaptation of Nabokov's novel about a literature professor who becomes obsessed with a precocious 14-year-old girl.

true-romance.overview: Clarence marries hooker Alabama, steals cocaine from her pimp, and tries to sell it in Hollywood, while the mob is on their trail.

reviews.quote: A celebration of toughness and romance — exhilarating in a way that movies rarely are.

faster-pussycat-kill-kill.overview: Three wild go-go dancers embark on a violent road trip through the California desert, terrorizing everyone they encounter.

motorpsycho.overview: A veterinarian and a woman whose husband was killed by a gang of motorcycle thugs team up to track down the vicious bikers across the desert.

showgirls.overview: A young drifter arrives in Las Vegas to become a dancer and soon sets about clawing and pushing her way to become the top showgirl in the city.

reviews.quote: Verhoeven's most misunderstood film is actually a lacerating satire of American entertainment culture — misread as trash, it's brilliant provocation.

the-decameron.overview: Pasolini's adaptation of nine stories from Boccaccio's medieval classic, exploring themes of love, lust, and deception in 14th-century Naples.

reviews.quote: Pasolini's ribald, earthy adaptation celebrates the human body and carnal joy with a painter's eye.

venus-in-furs.overview: A jazz musician finds the body of a woman on the beach and becomes haunted by her spirit, drawn into a surreal world of desire and revenge.

belle-de-jour.overview: A young newlywed with masochistic fantasies secretly works as a prostitute in a Parisian brothel during the afternoon while her husband is at work.

reviews.quote: A film of surreal erotic power, made with the cool detachment that was Buñuel's trademark.

fellini-s-casanova.overview: Fellini's extravagant portrait of the legendary 18th-century lover Giacomo Casanova, depicting his amorous adventures across Europe as a hollow quest for meaning.

henry-june.overview: In 1931 Paris, Anaïs Nin meets Henry Miller and his wife June. Intrigued by them both, she begins a tumultuous journey of self-discovery.

reviews.quote: Kaufman's lush adaptation captures bohemian Paris with a sensuality that earned the first-ever NC-17 rating.

last-tango-in-paris.overview: A young Parisian woman meets a middle-aged American businessman who demands their clandestine relationship be based only on physical sensation.

reviews.quote: Brando gives one of the most naked performances in cinema history, but the film's exploitative treatment of Schneider casts a long shadow.

little-shop-of-horrors.overview: A nerdy florist finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant who demands to be fed blood.

reviews.quote: A musical comedy that is also a witty satire — Frank Oz brings the skid-row fairy tale to hilarious life.

sinners.overview: Twin brothers return to their hometown in the Jim Crow-era South, hoping to start a new life but instead confronting a force far more terrifying than the world they left behind.

thunder-road.overview: A police officer struggles with the death of his mother, his failing marriage, and his inability to control his emotions in this darkly comedic drama.

the-more-the-merrier.overview: During the housing shortage of World War II Washington D.C., a young woman is persuaded to share her apartment with a retired millionaire, who then sublets to a handsome young sergeant.

reviews.quote: A wartime screwball delight with Jean Arthur at her most effervescent, capped by one of the great seduction scenes in Hollywood history.

solaris.overview: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a mysterious planet called Solaris to investigate the crew's strange behavior and discovers that the ocean may be a sentient being.

reviews.quote: Tarkovsky's deeply humanistic science fiction poem about memory, love, and the limits of knowledge.

the-birds.overview: A wealthy San Francisco socialite pursues a potential boyfriend to a small Northern California town that slowly takes a turn for the bizarre when birds begin to attack people.

reviews.quote: Hitchcock's most audacious experiment — the terror comes not from the birds themselves but from the inexplicability of it all.

the-wicker-man.overview: A devoutly Christian police sergeant travels to a remote Scottish island to investigate a missing girl and encounters a pagan community with dark secrets.

reviews.quote: A singular folk horror masterpiece — one of the greatest British films ever made.

django-unchained.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

reviews.quote: A series of showdowns that balance horror and exhilaration, building toward one of the most satisfying climaxes in recent memory.

playtime.overview: Monsieur Hulot curiously wanders around a futuristic Paris, meeting an American tourist group and trying to find his way in the ultra-modern architecture.

reviews.quote: One of the most extraordinary of all films. Tati works on vast canvases, filling them with minute, exquisitely detailed comic ideas.
The grandest and most generously conceived comedy ever made. It teaches you how to see, in the deepest sense.

the-warriors.overview: A gang blamed for the death of a charismatic rival leader must fight their way from the Bronx back to their home turf on Coney Island.

reviews.quote: A stylish, relentless urban odyssey that has lost none of its visceral power.

darby-o-gill-and-the-little-people.overview: A wily Irish caretaker matches wits with the king of the leprechauns and must use all his cleverness to win his daughter's happiness.

project-hail-mary.overview: An astronaut wakes up on a spaceship with no memory of how he got there, and must piece together his mission to save Earth from an extinction-level threat.

super-fly.overview: A successful Harlem drug dealer plans one last big score before retiring from the business and going straight.

reviews.quote: Elevated beyond its genre by Curtis Mayfield's transcendent score — one of the great blaxploitation films.

moulin-rouge-in-35mm.overview: A young English poet falls in love with the star of the Moulin Rouge, a nightclub where the bohemian values of beauty, freedom, truth, and love reign supreme.

reviews.quote: Luhrmann creates a dazzling spectacle — the movie is an series of explosions of energy and emotion.

interview-with-the-vampire.overview: A vampire tells his epic life story — of love, betrayal, loneliness, and hunger — to an unsuspecting reporter as the tape recorder rolls.

reviews.quote: A lavish, atmospheric adaptation that captures the melancholy and sensuality of Anne Rice's gothic world.

longlegs-sold-out.overview: An FBI agent assigned to an unsolved serial killer case discovers a personal connection to the elusive killer and uncovers occult evidence.

sweet-charity.overview: A New York dance hall hostess with a heart of gold keeps falling for the wrong men while hoping to find true love and escape her circumstances.

reviews.quote: Fosse's directorial debut overflows with kinetic choreography and MacLaine's unstoppable energy, even when the story falters.

the-running-man.overview: Edgar Wright's reimagining of the Stephen King story about a desperate man who enters a deadly game show where contestants are hunted across the country.

reviews.quote: Schwarzenegger at his wisecracking best, in a dystopian thriller that now looks eerily prescient about reality television.

frankenstein.overview: An obsessed scientist assembles a living being from parts of exhumed corpses, only to discover that the creature he has brought to life is a monster.

reviews.quote: James Whale brought a poetic quality to the horror genre that elevated it beyond mere thrills.

the-wizard-of-oz.overview: Young Dorothy Gale and her dog Toto are swept away by a tornado from their Kansas farm to the magical Land of Oz, and embark on a quest to see the Wizard.

reviews.quote: As a child I simply liked it. As an adult I found myself fascinated by it. It is a wonderful film in many ways.
A work of genuine imagination and visual daring that still enchants audiences after all these decades.

the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly.overview: A bounty hunting scam joins two men in an uneasy alliance against a third in a race to find a fortune in gold buried in a remote cemetery.

reviews.quote: A bizarre, engrossing, overlong, skillfully photographed work that somehow gets better with every viewing.
Leone's operatic masterpiece — the greatest western ever made and one of cinema's supreme achievements.

podcasts.name: The Rewatchables
podcasts.episode: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

giant.overview: Sprawling epic covering the life of a Texas cattle rancher, his family, and his conflict with a former ranch hand who strikes oil.

reviews.quote: An epic in every sense — sprawling, ambitious, and anchored by extraordinary performances.

lost-in-translation.overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo — a fading movie star and a neglected young woman — form an unlikely bond amid the neon-lit backdrop of the city.

reviews.quote: Everyone who sees the film will understand it in their own way, based on what they know about loneliness and connection.
A series of quiet revelations, a lovely, melancholy film about the mystery of human connection.

the-maltese-falcon.overview: San Francisco private detective Sam Spade takes on a case that involves him with three eccentric criminals, a gorgeous liar, and their quest for a priceless statuette.

reviews.quote: The first great detective film noir, the first to show that the weights and measures of pulp fiction could produce art.
A masterpiece of hardboiled cinema that remains endlessly rewatchable and quotable.

podcasts.name: Filmspotting
podcasts.episode: John Huston Marathon: The Maltese Falcon

la-dolce-vita.overview: A series of stories following a week in the life of a philandering paparazzo journalist living in Rome, exploring themes of decadence and emptiness.

reviews.quote: Fellini's masterwork — a sprawling, intoxicating journey through modern Rome that redefined what cinema could be.
Every scene pulses with Fellini's genius for spectacle and his deep melancholy about the human condition.

bicycle-thieves.overview: In post-war Italy, a working-class man's bicycle is stolen. He and his son set out on a desperate search through the streets of Rome to find it.

reviews.quote: De Sica tells this story with such simplicity and directness that it speaks to anyone, anywhere, who has ever been poor or felt helpless.
No more actors, no more story, no more sets — the perfect aesthetic illusion of reality.

babe-pig-in-the-city.overview: Babe the gallant pig, along with Farmer Hoggett's wife, travels to the big city where they encounter a whole new world of animals and adventures.

reviews.quote: George Miller's dark, visionary sequel is that rare children's film willing to confront cruelty and sorrow head-on.

viridiana.overview: A young nun about to take her vows visits her uncle, who tries to seduce her, setting off a chain of events that challenges her faith.

reviews.quote: Buñuel at his most savage and blackly comic — a devastating satire of charity, religion, and human nature.

american-graffiti.overview: A group of teenagers in 1962 California spend one last evening together before college, cruising the strip, racing, and falling in love.

reviews.quote: A brilliant work of observation. Not a masterwork of plot, but of atmosphere, a portrait of small-town teenage America.

jeanne-dielman-23-quai-du-commerce-1080-.overview: A methodical, quietly desperate housewife's routine of cooking, cleaning, and prostitution begins to subtly unravel over the course of three days.

reviews.quote: Akerman transforms the mundane into a kind of cinematic revolution, making the invisible labor of women radically visible.
One of the most extraordinary and daring films ever made — feminist cinema at its purest.
A towering masterwork of feminist cinema that demands and rewards patience.

24-hour-party-people.overview: The story of Factory Records and the Manchester music scene, told through the eyes of its eccentric founder Tony Wilson, from the Sex Pistols to the Happy Mondays.

reviews.quote: A witty, exuberant celebration of Manchester's music scene — messy, funny, and completely irresistible.

uhf.overview: "Weird Al" Yankovic gets to run a TV station and creates a lineup of bizarre shows that skyrocket the station to the top of the ratings.

grave-of-the-fireflies.overview: In the final months of World War II, a teenage boy and his young sister struggle to survive in the Japanese countryside after being separated from their parents.

reviews.quote: One of the greatest war films ever made — an emotional devastation that few live-action films can match.

point-break.overview: An FBI agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers, but he gets drawn into their lifestyle and finds himself torn between duty and loyalty.

reviews.quote: Bigelow handles the action sequences with pure kinetic energy — the surfing, the skydiving, the chases are all first-rate.

ravenous.overview: In 1840s California, a disgraced soldier at a remote military outpost discovers the disturbing truth about a mysterious stranger who wanders out of the wilderness.

reviews.quote: An audacious, blackly funny cannibal western with one of the great unsung film scores — Damon Albarn and Michael Nyman's music is genius.

the-gang-s-all-here.overview: A serviceman falls for a showgirl at a New York nightclub, leading to romantic complications in this colorful wartime musical extravaganza.

high-school.overview: Frederick Wiseman's landmark documentary observes the day-to-day activities at a large urban high school, revealing the institution's underlying power structures.

chico-rita.overview: An animated love story set against the backdrop of the golden age of Cuban music, following a young pianist and a beautiful singer from Havana to New York and beyond.

thx-1138.overview: In a dystopian future where the populace is controlled through android police and mandatory sedation, one man dares to stop taking his drugs and escape.

reviews.quote: Lucas's debut is a stark, chilling vision of a dehumanized future — all the more impressive for its micro-budget ingenuity.

black-girl.overview: A young Senegalese woman moves to France to work for a wealthy white family, only to discover that she is expected to be their servant in every way.

reviews.quote: A landmark of African cinema — powerful, economical, and emotionally devastating in its simplicity.

bright-star.overview: The three-year romance between 19th century poet John Keats and Fanny Brawne, which was cut short by his early death at age 25.

reviews.quote: Campion renders the Keats-Brawne romance with a luminous, tactile beauty — you can practically feel the fabric of the costumes.

the-gleaners-and-i.overview: Agnès Varda travels the French countryside with her handheld camera, documenting modern-day gleaners — those who pick up what others leave behind.

reviews.quote: A joyful, deeply personal film — Varda transforms the act of scavenging into a meditation on art, mortality, and what we value.

belly.overview: Two childhood friends and criminal partners in Queens find their bond tested as one seeks to leave the life of crime while the other gets pulled deeper in.

reviews.quote: Whatever its narrative shortcomings, Belly is one of the most visually stunning crime films ever shot — every frame is a painting.

jackass-number-two.overview: Johnny Knoxville and his crew of daredevils return for another round of outrageous stunts, pranks, and self-inflicted pain.

the-hitch-hiker.overview: Two fishermen pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psychotic escaped convict, and find themselves in a desperate fight for survival.

reviews.quote: Lupino's taut, ruthless thriller is a landmark — the first American film noir directed by a woman, and one of the leanest ever made.

a-mighty-wind-on-35mm.overview: Three folk groups reunite for a memorial concert for a beloved folk music manager who has passed away, revealing what happened to them since their glory days.

zama.overview: A Spanish colonial magistrate in 18th-century South America waits desperately for a transfer to a better post while his life slowly disintegrates around him.

reviews.quote: Martel's masterful period film transforms colonial waiting into existential dread — a slow-burn of extraordinary power.

seven-beauties.overview: An Italian man during World War II tries to survive by any means necessary, from deserting the army to seducing the female commandant of a concentration camp.

reviews.quote: Wertmuller's savage, grotesque masterwork — Giannini's performance is one of the great feats of physical acting.

new-jack-city.overview: A crime lord ascends to power through the crack epidemic in New York City, and a maverick cop is determined to bring him down.

reviews.quote: Wesley Snipes gives a galvanizing performance as Nino Brown — a crack-era kingpin drawn with pulp energy and real menace.

blue-velvet.overview: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals.

reviews.quote: Lynch peels back the surface of a typical American town and shows the rot underneath — a dark, fascinating vision.
The work of a genuine, visionary artist who sees into our shared nightmares.

zardoz.overview: In the distant future, a savage trained only to kill discovers a way into the community of bored combatants that have achieved eternal life.

reviews.quote: Boorman's delirious sci-fi folly is either a misunderstood masterpiece or a magnificent disaster — possibly both at once.

kung-fu-panda-2.overview: Po and the Furious Five discover a threat to all of kung fu, and must travel across China to face a peacock villain who has a lethal new weapon.

harold-and-maude.overview: Young, wealthy, and obsessed with death, Harold finds himself changed forever when he meets lively septuagenarian Maude at a funeral.

reviews.quote: One of the rare films that grow better with time — a death-obsessed comedy that is really about choosing to live.

romy-and-michele-s-high-school-reunion.overview: Two ditzy best friends concoct an elaborate lie about their post-high school accomplishments when they attend their 10-year high school reunion.

groove.overview: Over the course of one long night in San Francisco, the lives of several people intersect at an illegal underground rave.

national-gallery.overview: Frederick Wiseman takes an intimate look inside London's National Gallery, exploring how the museum presents its masterpieces to the public and operates behind the scenes.

reviews.quote: Wiseman's patient, immersive documentary reveals how a great museum lives and breathes — it's a meditation on art itself.

the-muppets-take-manhattan.overview: Kermit and his friends go to New York City to get their show on Broadway, but the road to success is anything but smooth.

salaam-bombay.overview: A boy from a traveling circus is abandoned in Bombay, where he must survive on the streets among drug dealers, prostitutes, and other marginalized people.

reviews.quote: A film of enormous power — Mira Nair captures the streets of Bombay with an immediacy that is heartbreaking and unforgettable.

thank-you-for-smoking.overview: A tobacco lobbyist who is great at his job — that is, spinning arguments in favor of cigarettes — faces increased pressure from health advocates and must also manage fatherhood.

reviews.quote: A wickedly funny satire that turns spin into an art form — sharp, smart, and endlessly quotable.

spring-breakers.overview: Four college girls who land in jail after robbing a restaurant in order to fund their spring break vacation find themselves bailed out by a drug and arms dealer.

reviews.quote: Korine has made a neon-drenched fever dream that is simultaneously a celebration and an indictment of American excess.

ali-fear-eats-the-soul-on-35mm.overview: An older German woman falls in love with a much younger Arab worker, and their relationship faces intense prejudice from family and society.

reviews.quote: Fassbinder takes a Douglas Sirk melodrama and transforms it into a devastating portrait of prejudice and loneliness.

beaches.overview: A privileged rich debutante and a tough-talking girl from the other side of the tracks maintain a lifelong friendship through letters and chance meetings.

reviews.quote: Midler and Hershey generate genuine warmth and chemistry, elevating a shameless tearjerker into something truly affecting.

love-streams.overview: An aging writer with a drinking problem and his emotionally fragile sister confront their inability to connect with others or sustain lasting relationships.

reviews.quote: Cassavetes' final masterpiece — raw, searching, and heartbreakingly beautiful in its exploration of love's impossibility.

son-of-the-white-mare.overview: An animated retelling of ancient Hungarian and Central Asian myths about three brothers who descend into the underworld to rescue three princesses from dragons.

reviews.quote: A psychedelic masterpiece of Hungarian animation — a swirling cosmos of myth and color unlike anything else in cinema.

empire-records.overview: The employees of a small independent record store learn that their beloved shop is about to be absorbed by a large chain, and take drastic action.

reviews.quote: The critical consensus missed what audiences didn't — a perfectly time-capsuled 90s hangout movie with an irresistible soundtrack.

almost-famous.overview: A high-school boy in the early 1970s is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies them on their concert tour.

reviews.quote: A movie about the world of rock that tells its story through the eyes of a teenage journalist — warm, funny, and deeply human.

paprika.overview: When a device that allows therapists to enter patients' dreams is stolen, a young female therapist must pursue the thief into the dreamworld.

reviews.quote: A surreal, visually ravishing journey into the subconscious that ranks among the best animated films ever made.

waiting-for-guffman.overview: An aspiring director in a small Missouri town rallies the community to put on a musical celebrating the town's 150th anniversary, hoping a Broadway agent will attend.

reviews.quote: Christopher Guest's mockumentary genius at its peak — simultaneously hilarious and oddly touching.

breathless.overview: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he reunites with a hip American journalism student.

reviews.quote: Modern movies begin here, with Godard's anarchic, jump-cutting, tradition-smashing first feature.
Breathless changed everything — it's the Big Bang of modern cinema.

funny-games.overview: Two psychopathic young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation home and play sadistic games with them.

reviews.quote: Haneke makes us complicit in the violence we watch for entertainment — a profoundly uncomfortable and essential film.

freeway.overview: A young woman on her way to grandma's house is waylaid by a charming serial killer, in this dark retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

reviews.quote: Reese Witherspoon tears through this deranged Little Red Riding Hood update with a ferocity that announced a major talent.

body-double.overview: A young actor's obsession with spying on a beautiful woman who lives nearby leads to a nightmarish chain of events with drastic consequences.

reviews.quote: De Palma at his most provocative — a brilliantly constructed thriller that interrogates the very act of looking.

the-holy-mountain.overview: A Christlike figure wanders through bizarre, grotesque scenarios filled with religious and mystical symbolism on a quest for immortality.

reviews.quote: The most ambitious work of its era — a hallucinatory spiritual odyssey unlike anything else in cinema.

the-juniper-tree.overview: In medieval Iceland, two sisters flee after their mother is burned for witchcraft. The elder uses sorcery to win the love of a widowed farmer.

beyond-the-mat.overview: A documentary that goes behind the curtain of professional wrestling to reveal the real lives, struggles, and sacrifices of its larger-than-life performers.

weathering-with-you.overview: A high-school boy who has run away to Tokyo befriends a girl who appears to be able to manipulate the weather, bringing sunshine in the midst of the city's endless rain.

the-rocky-horror-picture-show.overview: A newly engaged couple have a breakdown in an isolated area and must seek shelter at the bizarre residence of Dr. Frank-N-Furter.

reviews.quote: A camp masterpiece that continues to inspire midnight devotion — cinema's greatest audience participation event.

safety-last.overview: A boy leaves his small-town sweetheart to seek fame and fortune in the big city and ends up dangling from a clock face on the side of a skyscraper.

reviews.quote: One of the great comic thrill rides — the clock-hanging sequence remains one of cinema's most iconic images.

blow-up.overview: A mod London photographer realizes that he has captured a murder on film after developing photos he took in a park.

reviews.quote: One of the great art films — it teaches us about the difference between what we see and what we think we see.

conversation-piece.overview: A reclusive American professor living in Rome has his ordered existence disrupted when a vulgar Italian marchesa and her entourage move into his upstairs apartment.

clockstoppers.overview: A teenager discovers a watch that can speed up the wearer's molecular structure so much that the world around him appears to freeze.

the-face-of-another.overview: A man whose face has been horribly disfigured in an accident obtains a lifelike mask from his doctor and begins a new life with a new identity.

reviews.quote: Teshigahara creates a haunting philosophical puzzle about identity, alienation, and the masks we all wear.

persona.overview: A nurse is put in charge of a mute actress and finds that their personalities begin to merge in unexpected ways.

reviews.quote: What is it about? It is about two women, one who speaks and one who does not, and about how they merge and separate.
The construction of Persona is best described as a theme and variations — the theme being played and replayed with inexhaustible ingenuity.

barry-lyndon.overview: An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

reviews.quote: This must be one of the most beautiful films ever made. Every frame is a painting.
It was the most important movie of the 1970s to me. Each image was like a window into the past.

la-captive.overview: A young man living in Paris with his girlfriend becomes increasingly obsessed with her mysterious past and the women in her life, inspired by Proust.

beauty-and-the-beast.overview: A young woman whose father has been imprisoned by a terrifying beast offers herself in his place, unaware that her captor is actually a prince under an enchantment.

reviews.quote: A lovely film, the best Disney animated feature since the glory days of Walt.
A gorgeous, old-fashioned enchantment that scrapes away the lacquer of nostalgia to find something achingly true underneath.
Chazelle has made a series of films about artists who sacrifice everything. This one counts the cost.
No finer film has ever been made about organized crime — not even The Godfather.
Scorsese's mob epic is so tightly wound, so exhilarating, you almost forget you're watching psychopaths.
A series of post-modern, overlapping stories that are both exhilarating and appalling, funny and profound.
Tarantino's masterpiece is a series of interlocking tales told with electrifying wit and bottomless movie love.
Nolan's most ambitious film is a humbling, awe-inspiring vision of what cinema can do when it reaches for the infinite.
A movie that wears its heart on its sleeve, often to powerful effect — an intimate epic about love across dimensions.
Spielberg delivers the ultimate thrill ride — an adventure so primal it taps into childhood wonder and terror in equal measure.
It is a true movie milestone, presenting awe and terror that is completely convincing.
Fincher's razor-sharp adaptation is a toxic love story that doubles as a media satire of lacerating intelligence.
A brilliantly nasty entertainment that takes a wrecking ball to the institution of marriage.
A maximalist explosion of creativity that somehow resolves into the most tender film about a mother-daughter relationship in years.
An exuberant swirl of genre anarchy held together by a big, beating heart and Michelle Yeoh's magnificent performance.
The first Japanese noodle western — an utterly unique comedy that celebrates food as an expression of love, art, and life.
A film of quietly accumulating enchantment — Jarmusch finds the poetry in the ordinary and makes it extraordinary.
Jarmusch's most gentle and profound film, a hymn to the inner creative life that sustains us all.
The Godfather is told entirely within a closed world, and that's what makes it so chilling — it's a story of American ambition warped by loyalty.
The greatest gangster film ever made, and one of the most influential narrative films of all time.
The rare Apatow-produced comedy where the sentimentality doesn't feel forced — it's genuinely, messily human.
Heath Ledger's incandescent charm powers a teen comedy that's smarter and more literate than it has any right to be.
A rare romantic film that takes Black love seriously and gives it the lush, literary treatment it deserves.
Ray strips away the veneer of urban sophistication to reveal the petty cruelties and self-deceptions lurking underneath.
A fascinatingly incomplete relic of silent-era excess, with Swanson giving a remarkable performance under von Stroheim's lavish direction.
Stanwyck is magnificent, playing a woman who weaponizes her sexuality with a cold, clear-eyed pragmatism that still shocks.
Altman at his most anarchic and inventive — a wild, unclassifiable fable about the dream of flight and American freedom.
A fitfully entertaining but deeply confused finale that mistakes fan service for storytelling.
Guest's gentle mockumentary about folk music is his warmest film — the satire comes with genuine affection.
Sorvino and Kudrow are a sublime comic duo — their chemistry lifts this cult favorite into the stratosphere.

podcasts.name: The Rewatchables
podcasts.episode: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion

reviews.quote: Fellini deliberately empties Casanova of all romance, creating a magnificent, grotesque pageant of joyless seduction.
